description: Watch and listen through the Cardputer Zero's camera from your phone

store.summary: See and hear through the camera from your phone: scan the QR, no app.
store.description:
Turn the Cardputer Zero into a portable security camera or an inspection camera for hard-to-see places. Open Lookout, scan the QR code with your phone, and your phone's browser shows the live camera - no app, no account, nothing leaves your Wi-Fi network.

- Live video in any phone or computer browser (480p, 720p or 1080p)
- Listen through the microphone with adjustable boost (+12/+24/+36 dB); the mic only runs while someone is listening
- Snapshots, rotate and full-screen on the phone; change quality from the phone
- Live preview on the Cardputer for aiming, plus a full-screen view
- Sleep mode turns the screen off; the camera only runs while someone is watching
- The Cardputer always shows when someone is watching or listening
- Private link: the QR code carries a secret key, and N makes a new one (and disconnects everyone)

Keys: Enter big QR, V full-screen view, Q quality, M mic on/off, G mic boost, R rotate 180, S sleep, N new link, hold Esc to exit.
